title: Game move reveal body
description: An entrant reveals the move it committed to when it entered a referee-run game (S985, register row DK685). Signed by the entrant. The log checks the entry is the signer's, that it carries a move_commit, that the season has closed (so no move is shown while entries are open), that the move and salt hash to the commitment (`move_mismatch`), and that it is revealed once. A referee reads revealed moves from the log and plays the game by fixed rules; an entrant that never reveals scores nothing. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

entry.description: The arena_entry record that carries the commitment.

move.description: The move: a small JSON object the game defines (for hide and seek: hide and order). At most 1,000 characters when written as JSON.

salt.description: At least 16 characters, never reused, so the commitment cannot be guessed from the move.
